title: Safehouse and Extraction
author: Ansel Brightwater
blurb: Hazel Delacroix, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
